crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her…
“ ‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there…

translations.web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translations.bsb: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
translations.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
translations.asv: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother-in-law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
